description: This Java class defines a command strategy for handling resource deletion commands within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It performs validation, updates the policy, and generates appropriate event and response objects for resource deletion requests.

classes.name: DeleteResourceStrategy
classes.description: Defines a strategy for handling resource deletion commands, extending an abstract policy command strategy class.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the deletion logic: validates the policy and resource, removes the resource if valid, and returns a result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag associated with the previous policy entity for versioning or concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific entity tag is suggested after the operation.
